tasks.label: Kindoo Mac worker: safe recovery status
args:
'const fs=require("fs");const cp=require("child_process");const text=fs.readFileSync(process.env.HOME+"/Library/Logs/kindoo-license-worker.out.log","utf8");for(const line of text.split("
").filter(line=>line.startsWith("[mac-setup]")).slice(-4))console.log(line);try{const text=cp.execFileSync("/bin/launchctl",["print","gui/"+process.getuid()+"/com.kindoo.license-worker"],{encoding:"utf8",stdio:["ignore","pipe","pipe"]});console.log(text.split("
").filter(line=>/^\s*(state|pid) =/.test(line)).join("
"));}catch{console.log("worker launch agent is stopped");}'
